name: wan2gp-minipaint-bridge
description: Lets the a1111-mini-paint-NEO extension ask this WanGP what image inputs it can accept right now, and hand it one PNG at a time. Adds no generation UI and changes no generation behaviour.
author: a1111-mini-paint-NEO

compatibility.note: The version range is an early filter only. Real compatibility is functional: the bridge resolves its components through the plugin API and reports ready=false with BRIDGE_COMPONENT_INCOMPATIBLE when a mandatory one is missing.
